Mini mPOS takes payments with the Adyen Terminal API and the Adyen Java API library. It can run on the payment terminal, or use a terminal on your network or over the internet (cloud). Tap to Pay uses the Adyen Payments app on a phone. Mini mPOS encrypts messages to a terminal or the Payments app with the shared key. Cloud requests use your API key for authentication.
